title: podocarpus pilgeri subsp. wangii
intro: Podocarpus pilgeri subsp. wangii, commonly known as the Wang's podocarpus, is a species of coniferous tree in the family Podocarpaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving fever, and treating respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Wang's podocarpus include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant effects, making it a potential remedy for respiratory conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Wang's podocarpus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
